list_accounts.effect: Returns owned connected accounts, readiness and trial allowance; cannot connect or disconnect them.

get_tiktok_creator_info.effect: Reads TikTok posting options for an owned account via its provider; does not publish.

inspect_posts.effect: Returns paginated drafts, scheduled, posted and failed items and per-account results.

get_schedule.effect: Returns posting slots and calendar data without modifying schedules.

show_schedule.effect: Returns the calendar with text/data fallback and an optional MCP Apps view.

show_post_preview.conditionalScopes: posts:read for saved postId; posts:validate for supplied unsaved content
show_post_preview.effect: Renders saved or supplied content with a text fallback; does not save, import, validate or publish.

upload_media.effect: Imports a public image/video URL or supported client attachment into owned storage; no post is published. Muse attachment handling is unverified; use approved public test URLs.

validate_post.effect: Validates exact text and media; can import media into owned storage, and fitting can create derivatives. Does not create a post. Mixed read/write even when a text-only invocation has no media side effect.

preview_post.effect: Resolves timing, accounts, quote source and validation. Uses the same media-importing validation path; never schedules or publishes.

create_post.effect: Saves a draft, schedules future public publication or publishes now, selected by postingMode. Whole tool must ask every time because it can publish. Retain idempotencyKey across an uncertain retry; inspect returned post and per-account postingResults.

update_scheduled_post.effect: Changes a draft or future scheduled post, including content, destinations and time. Can affect future public content; cannot edit already-published platform content.

discard_scheduled_post.effect: Deletes a draft or future scheduled post and may queue owned media for deletion. Cannot retract an already-published post.

open_simplepost_workspace.effect: Returns calendar, accounts and working-copy summaries; optional sidebar view does not create posts.

get_simplepost_workspace.effect: Refreshes workspace data without modifying posts.

open_post_editor.effect: Returns editor launch context and optional UI; opening alone does not create a working copy or publish.

start_post_editor_session.effect: Creates a recoverable working copy; not a saved social post or publication.

read_post_editor_session.effect: Returns the owned working copy and revision; cannot modify it.

update_post_editor_session.effect: Replaces working-copy content and clears its pending proposal without retaining undo history. Treat this destructive overwrite conservatively as sensitive even though it does not publish.

propose_post_edit.effect: Stores a separate reviewable patch at the current revision; does not apply it or change saved posts.

commit_post_editor_session.effect: Saves, schedules or publicly publishes the reviewed working copy. Whole tool requires approval every invocation; expectedRevision protects concurrent edits.

validate_post_editor_session.effect: Validates the owned working copy and may import or fit media. Does not commit or publish; not available under read-only consent.

read_simplepost_settings.effect: Returns publishing preferences and their settings schema; no changes.

update_simplepost_settings.effect: Updates timezone, calendar view or default destinations. Does not move existing scheduled instants or publish.
